title: India unveils ₹1.2 lakh crore semiconductor mission
raw: The Union Cabinet approved a ₹1.2 lakh crore semiconductor mission to build three new fabrication plants and attract global chipmakers. The scheme offers capital subsidies and aims to create about 90,000 jobs over five years.
summary: India's Union Cabinet approved a ₹1.2 lakh crore semiconductor mission to build three new fabrication plants. The initiative aims to attract global chipmakers and create approximately 90,000 jobs over five years. This move positions India as a key player in the global semiconductor industry.

title: RBI keeps repo rate at 6.5%, signals data-dependent path
raw: The Reserve Bank of India held the repo rate at 6.5% for the eighth straight meeting, citing sticky food inflation. The governor said future moves depend on incoming data, and retained the GDP growth forecast at 7%.
summary: The Reserve Bank of India maintained the repo rate at 6.5% for the eighth consecutive meeting, addressing persistent food inflation. The RBI governor emphasized a data-dependent approach for future rate decisions and kept the GDP growth forecast at 7%. This highlights the central bank's cautious stance amid inflation concerns.

title: Monsoon arrives early over Kerala, IMD confirms
raw: The southwest monsoon reached Kerala two days ahead of schedule, the India Meteorological Department said. IMD forecast above-normal rainfall this season, easing concerns for kharif sowing.
summary: The southwest monsoon reached Kerala two days early, the India Meteorological Department confirmed. IMD forecasts above-normal rainfall this season, alleviating concerns for kharif sowing. This early arrival could impact agricultural planning and water resource management in the region.

title: Supreme Court upholds electoral bonds verdict
raw: The Supreme Court declined to review its earlier judgment striking down the electoral bonds scheme. The bench said transparency in political funding outweighs donor anonymity.
summary: The Supreme Court upheld its previous decision striking down the electoral bonds scheme, emphasizing transparency in political funding over donor anonymity. This decision follows ongoing debates about the scheme's impact on election integrity. The ruling reinforces the court's stance on maintaining transparency in political contributions.

title: Sensex closes above 82,000 for first time
raw: The BSE Sensex closed above 82,000 for the first time, gaining 1.1% led by IT and banking stocks. Strong foreign investor inflows and easing US bond yields drove the rally.
summary: The BSE Sensex closed above 82,000 for the first time, gaining 1.1% led by IT and banking stocks. Strong foreign investor inflows and easing US bond yields drove the rally. This milestone reflects investor confidence and favorable global financial conditions.

title: ISRO sets date for Gaganyaan crewed test flight
raw: ISRO announced the first crewed Gaganyaan test flight is targeted for early next year. The mission will carry three astronauts to low-earth orbit for a three-day flight.
summary: ISRO announced the first crewed Gaganyaan test flight is targeted for early next year. The mission will carry three astronauts to low-earth orbit for a three-day flight. This marks a significant step in India's human spaceflight program.

title: Delhi air quality dips to 'very poor' ahead of winter
raw: Delhi's air quality index slipped into the 'very poor' category as stubble burning and falling temperatures trapped pollutants. Authorities restricted construction and diesel generators.
summary: Delhi's air quality index fell to 'very poor' due to stubble burning and decreasing temperatures. Authorities responded by restricting construction activities and the use of diesel generators. These measures aim to mitigate pollution levels as winter approaches.

title: Global oil prices ease as OPEC+ weighs output
raw: Brent crude slipped 2% as OPEC+ signaled it may raise output next quarter. Traders weighed softer demand from China against Middle East supply risks.
summary: Brent crude prices fell 2% as OPEC+ indicated a potential output increase next quarter. The market is balancing reduced demand from China with ongoing supply risks in the Middle East. This development could influence global energy costs and economic forecasts.

title: US Fed minutes hint at slower rate cuts
raw: Minutes from the US Federal Reserve meeting showed officials favor fewer rate cuts this year amid persistent services inflation. Markets trimmed bets on a near-term cut.
summary: The US Federal Reserve meeting minutes revealed officials support fewer rate cuts in 2026 due to ongoing services inflation. This led markets to reduce expectations for an imminent rate cut. The shift in monetary policy stance impacts investor strategies and economic forecasts.

title: Cabinet approves new rail freight corridor
raw: The Union Cabinet approved a new dedicated rail freight corridor worth ₹45,000 crore connecting two major ports. The project aims to cut logistics costs and is targeted for completion by 2030.
summary: The Union Cabinet approved a ₹45,000 crore rail freight corridor connecting two major ports. This project seeks to reduce logistics costs and is planned for completion by 2030. The new corridor is expected to enhance trade efficiency and economic growth.

title: State budget raises health spending 18%
raw: The state budget raised health spending by 18%, allocating funds for new district hospitals and medical colleges. The finance minister said the focus is on primary care access.
summary: The state budget raised health spending by 18%, funding new district hospitals and medical colleges. This increase focuses on improving primary care access, addressing long-standing healthcare infrastructure gaps. The enhanced funding aims to bolster healthcare services across the state.
